name: An Unwelcome Guest

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, helping Martie Jainrose brings relief and order to Lakeshire, where townspeople already face greater threats in Redridge.
As a hunter, you can track Bellygrub, the named beast roaming southwest of Lakeshire, through the Redridge Mountains.
As an herbalist, you know the care Martie Jainrose gave her flower patch. Bellygrub's rampage ruined her seasonal daffodils and damaged the town's domestic plant life.

aliases: where to get an unwelcome guest
faq.answer: Martie Jainrose asks for help in Lakeshire, the lakeside town in the Redridge Mountains. Her garden has suffered repeated damage, and she wants the boar responsible hunted down.
faq.q: Who gives the quest An Unwelcome Guest?

faq.answer: Bellygrub is an aggressive boar that terrorizes the grounds around Lakeshire. Marshal Marris, the town guard leader, gave him that name.
Bellygrub usually forages in the open fields southwest of Lakeshire. He often wanders closer to town and into residents' gardens.

aliases: why does martie want bellygrub dead
faq.answer: Bellygrub repeatedly trampled Martie Jainrose's garden and ruined her daffodils for the season. She wants him killed to stop the damage.
faq.q: Why does Martie Jainrose want Bellygrub killed?

faq.answer: Martie Jainrose asks you to bring her Bellygrub's tusk as proof that the boar has been dealt with. She will reward you for it.
faq.q: What proof is needed to complete the quest?

faq.answer: Marshal Marris leads Lakeshire's town guard. He named the boar Bellygrub, while Martie Jainrose seeks vengeance for her ruined daffodils.
faq.q: Who is Marshal Marris and what is his connection to the beast?

sections.body: Martie Jainrose lives in Lakeshire, a town by the lake beneath the gathering shadows over the Redridge Mountains. A wild boar keeps breaking into her garden and ruining the peace of her home. Bellygrub has trampled her daffodils beyond recovery for the season. Now Martie asks travelers to end the animal's rampage.
sections.title: Trouble in the Garden

sections.body: Marshal Marris, who leads Lakeshire's town guard, gave the boar his name: Bellygrub. He spends most of his time rooting through the fields southwest of town. His hunger and boldness bring him close to homes, where he ruined Martie's flower beds. The damage has left her wanting him gone.
sections.title: The Menace of Bellygrub

summary: In Lakeshire, Martie Jainrose asks you to stop Bellygrub for good. The wild boar wrecked her garden and trampled her daffodils, and she offers a bounty for his tusk.
